author: mmarchegiani
body:
#### PR description:

This PR implements the associator between TICL LayerClusters and the truth branch defined with MC truth graph.
Similarly to the associator for TICL Tracksters, it defines the reco-to-sim association for LayerClusters.

This PR and PR #52475 touch the same file `SimGeneral/TruthGraphAssociatorProducers/plugins/AllRecoToTruthBranchAssociatorsProducer.cc`.
However, there is no direct conflict since the changes are compatible with each other.
